module.image.name: Image / slider
module.image.description: One image or several as a slider, from the media library
module.image.images.help: One image is simply shown, two or more become a slider. The alt text comes from the media library.
module.image.missing: Image is missing in the media library
module.image.title: Label for screen readers
module.image.title.help: Optional. Read aloud but not shown, e.g. "Photos from the concert".
module.image.autoplay.help: Visitors can pause it at any time; anyone who prefers less motion sees it paused.
module.image.alt_edit: Add it in the media library
